thought_experiments.setup_and_result: Bless and Curse stack. The working comparison uses +1 and −1 per stack on every attack hit, with a floor of 0. Percentage scaling is still open; this preview is not a settled numerical rule.
thought_experiments.implication: No Mark or Weaken remains in current effects.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: The Radiant Moth has 18 HP and opens with 4 Radiance. Angel grants 5 Ward; Sun deals 6 Radiance. The Moth becomes 12 HP; its hit leaves 1 player Ward. That Ward halves to 0 at the next player turn start.
thought_experiments.implication: Damage and decay are separate steps.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: With no matching weakness, Prism’s three hits of 2 become 3, 3, 3 with Bless 1 in the flat candidate. The 25% candidate with nearest rounding also gives 3, 3, 3.
thought_experiments.implication: Other hit sizes diverge; inspect the scaling comparison.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: Porcelain Choir’s 2, 2, 2 becomes 1, 1, 1 with Curse 1 in the flat candidate. The 25% candidate with nearest rounding leaves 2, 2, 2.
thought_experiments.implication: Rounding can make a percentage debuff do nothing on small hits.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: Curse may reduce every direct hit to 0. Separate Burn, Poison, card moves, healing and trait clauses still resolve. Hush suppresses the labeled trait; an active Freeze skips the whole scheduled action.
thought_experiments.implication: Three distinct kinds of control remain.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: Vampire’s 4 Shadow plus a matching +2 weakness, plus Bless 1 minus Curse 2, has final flat damage 5. Leech heals 5 before Ward, including absorption and overkill, capped at maximum HP.
Apply weakness and Bless/Curse before Reflect. The redirected hit keeps that final value and type; do not apply modifiers again at its new target.
thought_experiments.implication: Burn, Poison and separate trait damage are not attacks.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: The Swan’s while-intent reflection remains active during Freeze. Hush suspends it; Purge consumes its active one-use reflection. If Freeze still exists at action start, skip the whole action.
thought_experiments.implication: Whether an intervening attack thaws Freeze is undecided; do not promise that sequence a final outcome.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: With Burn 7 and Curse 1, a one-random Cleanse chooses between two status kinds equally and clears the chosen counter entirely. Removing Curse first with a narrow cure guarantees that the later random Cleanse removes Burn.
thought_experiments.implication: Playing order replaces an extra selection menu.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: With Ward, Reflect and Bless active, one-random Purge has three eligible kinds. Purge all clears all three. It does not erase the printed trait or prevent later grants.
thought_experiments.implication: Stacks do not weight random selection.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: Ice Crystal Freezes and Banishes its source. If nothing intervenes that could thaw it, skip the enemy’s next action, advance the pattern and clear Freeze. Ward still halves.
thought_experiments.implication: Attack and Fire thaw rules remain open; current Freeze previews are conditional.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: Remaining Ward 7 becomes 3, then 1, then 0 at successive holder turn starts. Enemy Ward halves after damage-over-time ticks, even when its action is skipped.
With 5 Ward, 4 Burn and 3 Poison, take a 4 Fire tick then a 3 Decay tick. Ward absorbs 5 total; lose 2 HP. Burn becomes 2 and Poison becomes 1.
thought_experiments.implication: Separate typed ticks, both halving even when blocked.

thought_experiments.setup_and_result: Scry follows the current library top until End Turn begins. An empty library does not reshuffle for Scry; reveal a top supplied by a later draw or move.
Cocoon flips its own resolving physical card to Shed Skin, then Keeps that same card in hand. Finish the original played effect. Every later play still costs mana.

At enemy resolution, random held-card moves use the actual remaining hand after discard. Use all available cards if fewer than requested. Helpful recovery moves the top discarded card, rather than opening a selection prompt.
thought_experiments.implication: No retained-card snapshots or hidden physical identities.
